newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Inhale Therapeutic gets outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Inhale Therapeutic gets outperform.

text.p: -- Everen Securities said it began coverage of Inhale Therapeutic Systems Inc with an outperform rating. The company specializes in developing non-invasive methods for delivering proteins such as insulin to the body.
-- Everen analyst Al Rauch said he has a short term price target of $31 and a long term price target of $40.
-- Shares of Inhale Therapeutic Systems were trading off 5/8 to 18-3/8.
